verdict.rationale: Motion documents its own API reference, described as a complete guide to all endpoints, plus cookbooks with fully fleshed-out examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (e.g., a try-it console) or that the examples can be run in the browser. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable in-docs examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs experience
